item.title: “My Forever Son” — Fausat Balogun Reaffirms Support for MC Oluomo as She Shares Video of Their Reunion
item.description: Veteran Nollywood actress Fausat Balogun, popularly known as Madam Saje, has once again declared her loyalty and support for the National President of the National Union of Road Transport Workers (NURTW), MC Oluomo.Taking to her Instagram page, the Yoruba actress shared a video of herself with the NURTW boss at a recent event.
